Yinyang appendices

Yinyang practice overview

Forming your own Yinyang connects the views you adopt, an understanding of the actual participants, and an environment through which they can work. The point is a practice that enters life: what you can understand, create, judge, and do with a capable model counterpart. The author's Stealing fire develops this as cultivation through borrowed generative capacity. Your own philosophy can adopt, combine, challenge, and rewrite existing thought into a direction you choose.

Philosophy and models develop together

Begin by selecting views that help with an actual question, experience, or way of working, and state what you adopt in the working accounts. If philosophical writing interests you, literature, humanities, engineering, logic, and aesthetics can supply material for a fuller work. Maintaining Yinyang's six actual files does not require that separate writing project.

Philosophy articulates concepts, reasons, values, and possibilities. Personal material grounds their application to an actual person, counterpart, and relationship. Either can revise the other. A chosen direction differs from an explanation of experience; a desired model contribution differs from demonstrated capability. Forming and revising working models develops these connections and leads to the six writing files.

Starting conditions and order vary. You may already have philosophical expression, a history of personal inquiry, or a working environment. Develop the missing connections from there. A tool or a work can disclose a relation that later acquires philosophical expression. Selected views, revisable personal material, and practical arrangements can develop together whether or not you choose to turn that understanding into essays.

From six guides to six actual files

The public guides explain how to write orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision. The corresponding six private actual files articulate personal working models of person–model cooperation, intended to make the actual personal environment fit the person psychologically and practically. Psychological and life evidence and maintained interpretations principally belong in private references/personal/; the six files condense their working implications together with adopted philosophy. The revision guide teaches how to form a fitting revision method; the actual revision file carries that method. Forming and revising working models connects these six writing objects. Its maintenance method owns each refresh of the working files and the relevant private material.

Prompts, Skills, tools, and interfaces give understanding practical consequences, which can correct actual files and philosophy. Completed output, collaborative fit, and developing personal capacity call for evidence at their respective scales.

Using Yinyang

People and models can read and use these materials together: develop an argument, compare an account with experience, inspect an arrangement, or make an authorized change. Different writing forms serve different contributions without reserving philosophy for humans or practical understanding for models.

Everyday collaboration with Yinyang explains how the current six files cooperate in ordinary work. The package guide explains their common and private paths and shared updates. These are connected entrances, not a sequence to repeat for every task. The example and commons essay invites selective adoption, combination, and independent authorship.
